q2_gaps: a temporal / deictic adverb ('now') modifying a kind-level relational generic - the kind relation is an opaque binary atom with no event witness, so there is no slot for a Time atom and the 'now' (with its implied contrast to an earlier state) is unrepresentable
notes: Both arguments are bare kind-denoting NPs (mass subject, bare plurals), so the relational-generic kind relation with its 0.9/0.9 TV is the licensed route and 'Mean' is licensed as the lemmatized kind-relation head, not a coined one. The coordinated object distributes into three atoms as Coordination & plurals specifies.
